paragraphs: Kinotek sells technology for fitness professionals to perform movement health assessments and produce reports that educate clients. The homepage describes motion-capture technology that delivers personalized scored reports, and 3D visuals of how a client moves. On the about page the company states that it makes measuring movement health fast, easy, affordable and understandable so that professionals can help everyone.

The solutions page describes a LiDAR camera, a choice of 65 movements, and a 5-movement assessment completed in seconds. Reports are described in a client-friendly format showing mobility, imbalances, compensations and movement quality. The app is cloud-based with secure login, and custom playlists can be built around the needs of professionals and clients.

The homepage repeats a claim that gyms using the platform add annual revenue by turning movement health assessments into personal training opportunities. Named on the homepage are an owner at Snap Fitness, an assistant VP of fitness at Healthtrax, and a director at LifeTime Fitness.

quote.text: Kinotek makes measuring movement health fast, easy, affordable and understandable, so that professionals can help everyone.
